summary.name: Lifehacker
summary.one_liner: Lifehacker is a website publishing how-to guides, tips, and advice on optimizing everyday tasks, with tech deals coverage.
use_cases: Finding how-to guides for iOS, macOS, Android, or Windows
Reading productivity and life optimization tips
Looking up tech deals and product recommendations
Getting personal finance and home DIY advice
summary.what_it_does: The page is a Lifehacker homepage listing contributor bios rather than article content. It describes Lifehacker as a site focused on optimizing many aspects of everyday life. Contributors listed cover tech how-tos across iOS, macOS, Android, and Windows, tech deals, personal finance, travel, writing, and home maintenance. The page itself shows no specific tools, features, or downloadable products.
notable: Covers how-tos across iOS, macOS, Android, and Windows
Listed in awesome-mac under Genuine Sites
caveats: Page text is mostly contributor bios with little concrete article content
Pricing inferred from a public website with no stated paywall; the page does not state pricing explicitly
